title: Dallas Man Pleads Guilty to Carjacking, Brandishing Firearm
text:
DALLAS, Texas, Aug. 26, 2025 – A 22-year-old dallas man has admitted his role in a brazen carjacking and a subsequent high-speed chase through the Deep ellum neighborhood.
Man Pleads Guilty to Carjacking, Firearm Charges Dallas man admits guilt in Deep Ellum carjacking and chase.
Travion Amar Williams , 22, pleaded guilty on aug. 26, 2025. The charges stem from a Dec. 6, 2023, incident involving a stolen Corvette. Williams and accomplices robbed victims at gunpoint before fleeing. A high-speed chase ensued, ending with Williams’ arrest. sentencing is set for Jan. 14, 2026. Travion Amar Williams entered his guilty plea to one count of carjacking and one count of brandishing a firearm during a hearing before united States Magistrate Judge David Horan.
Carjacking Details Emerge Williams confessed that on December 6, 2023, he and two masked accomplices were waiting in a parked car. Two victims were walking to their 2020 Chevrolet Corvette, parked across from a restaurant in Dallas.
As the victims approached, Williams and an accomplice, armed with handguns, exited their vehicle. They forcefully took the Corvette’s key, a bracelet, a cell phone, and a wallet from the victims.
Did you know? – Williams and accomplices approached victims walking to their Corvette.They took the car key, a bracelet, a phone, and a wallet at gunpoint. The incident occurred on Dec. 6, 2023, in Dallas.
High-Speed Chase and Capture Williams and his accomplice then sped off in the stolen Corvette. The pair led law enforcement on a high-speed chase that eventually concluded when they abandoned the vehicle under a bridge overpass.
The duo fled on foot, jumping a fence and entering an industrial park. During the foot pursuit,Williams dropped a Glock,Model 19 Gen 5,9mm Parabellum caliber pistol he had during the carjacking. He was apprehended by authorities shortly thereafter.
Pro tip: – The high-speed chase ended when Williams and his accomplice abandoned the Corvette. Williams dropped his firearm during a foot pursuit.He was apprehended by authorities after the chase.
Sentencing Looms The Dallas Police Department and the Bureau of Alcohol,Tobacco,firearms and Explosives (ATF) conducted the examination into the incident.
williams’ sentencing hearing is scheduled for January 14, 2026.
Reader question: – What are the potential penalties for Williams? The sentencing hearing is set for Jan. 14, 2026. The charges include carjacking and brandishing a firearm. Details on the penalties will be revealed then.
